s4_writer_context.work_frame: School-supply buyer desk. Doyun brings one plain Haemun sample box to a distributor desk where the phone, return ledger, and front display already define the buyer's risk.
s4_writer_context.live_transaction: Doyun wants the sample to enter a school-goods shipment path, but the buyer can send the box back before even opening it. Doyun must reduce exposure enough that the buyer can leave the box on the desk.
s4_writer_context.priced_loss: The buyer risks parent calls, return handling, delivery penalties, shelf space, and next-month school quantity if a weak Haemun product reaches school buyers.
s4_writer_context.resistant_witness: Buyer Bae Sangrok protects his return ledger and phone line. He asks who collects returns and who answers school calls before product curiosity.
s4_writer_context.access_gain: The sample box remains beside the phone and return ledger with a memo for 30 pairs, return cap 3, school phone handled directly, and no front display.
behavior_ladder: Bae reads the Haemun label and presses the return ledger before opening the box.
Doyun does not push the box inward or ask for front display.
The first ask of 60 pairs is cut to 30 under buyer terms.
Bae writes visible limits into the memo: no front display, return cap 3, school calls handled by Haemun side.
The employee does not carry the box to the front shelf; he turns the label toward the phone.
s4_writer_context.final_price_tag_translation: Doyun has not won an order or display. He has moved Haemun from rejectable sample to a tolerated desk object attached to return responsibility and school-call handling.
s4_writer_context.final_receipt_and_next_gate: The box remains half visible beside the receiver and return ledger. Next gate is the school goods shipment/public-use trial.
